subject.title: test(release): harden shared UI and performance proof

question: Should this release-prep PR remain test-only by mirroring the current filtered chat settings adapter, or expand to fix production persistence of `lastActiveSessionKey`?
rationale: The helper clearly attempts to persist the active session, but fixing the production adapter would contradict the PR's stated no-runtime-change scope and requires an explicit scope choice.

options.title: Keep the PR test-only
options.body: Mirror the production adapter in the fixture, assert the full callback payload without pretending it was persisted, and track any runtime persistence fix separately.

options.title: Fix production persistence here
options.body: Update the chat-page adapter to persist `lastActiveSessionKey`, add focused runtime regression coverage, and document that this PR now changes Control UI behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the PR test-only
recommendation.body: Mirror the production adapter in the fixture, assert the full callback payload without pretending it was persisted, and track any runtime persistence fix separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across both the chat behavior and performance validation surfaces and authored the linked upstream evaluator change.
